probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Salto&Pan ® Growth agency for online shops and software companies Services Case studies Pricing About Overview Buy Kotei Overview Buy Kotei Services Case studies Pricing About Blog Free audit Contact Email and lifecycle Flows and campaigns that bring customers back, written and built in house. Get a free audit 31% Revenue from email The approach How we run it, and who it's for. Paying for a customer once is expensive. Paying for them twice is a waste. Email is how a shop sells to the people it already has, and it’s usually the cheapest revenue on the books. How we run it We start with the flows that run on their own: the welcome series, browse and cart reminders, and what happens after someone buys. Those are written, designed and live in the first six weeks. Then come the campaigns. Two a week, planned a month ahead around your launches and stock, with every send measured on revenue, not opens. Who it’s for Shops with at least 5,000 subscribers, or the traffic to get there. Software companies use it for trials and onboarding. What you get Every month, on one flat retainer.
